description: Dataset: Harmonized and Open Energy Dataset for Modeling a Highly Renewable Brazilian Power System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ying Deng, Karl-Kiên Cao (German Aerospace Center (DLR), Institute of Networked Energy Systems). The dataset provided here is intended for publication - Harmonized and Open Energy Dataset for Modeling a Highly Renewable Brazilian Power System. Direct use of our provided datasets is available from Zenodo, and the source code to generate the datasets is published in Gitlab. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
